name: @pipeworx/mcp-taginfo

tools.name: key_values
tools.description: OSM Taginfo: list the most common values for an OpenStreetMap key, by frequency (e.g. all amenity= values from "parking" down). Useful for understanding how features are tagged in OSM. Keyless.

tools.name: tag_stats
tools.description: OSM Taginfo: get usage counts (all / nodes / ways / relations) for a specific OpenStreetMap key=value tag, e.g. amenity=cafe. Keyless.

value.description: An OSM value for that key, e.g. "cafe".

tools.name: search_keys
tools.description: OSM Taginfo: search OpenStreetMap keys by text, ranked by total usage. Useful for discovering how features are tagged in OSM. Keyless.

query.description: Text to search keys for, e.g. "cuisine".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-taginfo forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the taginfo pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
